affected.product: Payment forms, Buy now buttons, and Invoicing System | GetPaid

descriptions.value: The Payment forms, Buy now buttons, and Invoicing System | GetPaid WordPress plugin before 2.8.63 does not check that the visitor is allowed to view an invoice before rendering it through its single-invoice shortcode, and its payment-form embed page lets unauthenticated users render that shortcode for any invoice ID, disclosing customers' names, billing addresses, phone numbers, line items and payment status.

descriptions.description: CWE-639 Authorization Bypass Through User-Controlled Key
